rubriker.title: ChessBase´26 – Tips for Beginners, part 32: Training with style
rubriker._rss_content: It’s once again time to think about aesthetics in ChessBase´26 training: Have you ever noticed the “Style” option? If not, in this episode we’ll explain briefly and concisely how you can better adapt your screen display to your own taste.

rubriker.title: Samarkand R4 (open): Eight-way tie at the top as favourites hold firm
rubriker._rss_content: The leading group in the open section of the Chess Olympiad was reduced to eight teams after round four, with China, Uzbekistan, Germany and Armenia still unbeaten on every individual board. Lithuania supplied the main surprise of the day by beating Croatia 3–1. With all eight co-leaders now paired against one another, Sunday's fifth round is set to reshape the top of the standings. | Pictured: China's Wei Yi | Photo: Michal Walusza / FIDE

rubriker.title: ChessBase interviews from Samarkand: "How many databases? Hundreds!"
rubriker._rss_content: ChessBase has a team on-site at the Chess Olympiad in Samarkand. Visitors to the ChessBase stand can find out more about ChessBase for Mac. Arne Kähler and Veronika Exler are also conducting interviews. Svitlana Demchenko has hundreds of databases, Nikita Vitiugov considers himself to be one of the best chefs among chess players, while Gloria Yepez does not enjoy playing blitz! | Photo: ChessBase

rubriker.title: Eight Teams Still Perfect After Round Four
rubriker._rss_content: Round four in Samarkand didn't produce a single upset among the tournament's top boards, but it did settle into a genuinely crowded picture at the summit: eight teams remain unbeaten after four rounds, and the day's best individual story came from a player who, by rights, should have lost.

rubriker.title: Putin Endorses Turlov for FIDE President
rubriker._rss_content: Russian independent outlet Agentstvo has reported that Vladimir Putin and Kazakh President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev discussed the FIDE presidency directly during a bilateral meeting in Omsk in late July, and that Kirsan Ilyumzhinov's withdrawal from the race just two days later followed from that conversation.

rubriker.title: Rosenstein Promises Magnus Carlsen Return
rubriker._rss_content: Wadim Rosenstein told Reuters this week that, if elected FIDE president, he would push to bring Magnus Carlsen back into the classical World Championship cycle, alongside a platform built around governance reform, greater transparency, and tougher conflict-of-interest rules.

rubriker.title: Olympiad Round 4 Opens with Makropoulos Tribute
rubriker._rss_content: Round four of the Chess Olympiad in Samarkand opened with a minute of silence for Georgios Makropoulos, who died earlier this week at 72 after devoting most of his adult life to the sport.

rubriker.title: Confirman detalles sobre el match por el Campeonato del Mundo: se jugará en la Biblioteca Bodmeriana de Ginebra
rubriker._rss_content: La FIDE se complace en anunciar el reglamento del Campeonato Mundial FIDE Salesforce 2026, que confirma la sede, el formato, el calendario y la distribución de premios del duelo entre el vigente campeón mundial, el gran maestro Gukesh Dommaraju, y su retador, el gran maestro Javokhir Sindarov. El encuentro se disputará en la Fondation Martin Bodmer, en Cologny, Ginebra, Suiza, del 22 de noviembre al 13 de diciembre de 2026, y supondrá el regreso de un match por el Campeonato Mundial a Suiza por primera vez desde Brissago 2004.
